meta.title: Agent work protocol
meta.description: Injects a portable work protocol into every agent's system prompt: a task line for new tasks, one-pass request refinement, semantic skill routing, few and precise clarifying questions (subagents never ask), strict mode for high-requirement work, and a delivery self-check. Ships lite / standard / strict presets, per-section switches and custom extra rules. This is model guidance, not a hard gate; it writes nothing to your profile and applies to agents of this profile only.
